intro.title: Welcome to Dayopt
intro.description: Plan your time, track what you actually do, and see where your hours go. Let's walk through the basics.

gridDragPlan.title: Create a plan
gridDragPlan.description: Drag on a future time slot to schedule what you want to do

selectTagPlan.title: Pick a tag
selectTagPlan.description: Choose a tag — it becomes the name and color of your plan

explainTags.title: Tags — Your Activity Categories
explainTags.description: Tags help you in three ways:

categorize.label: Categorize
categorize.detail: Group your time blocks by activity type

colorCode.label: Color-code
colorCode.detail: Each tag has its own color on the calendar

trackStats.label: Track stats
trackStats.detail: See exactly how much time you spend on each category

gridDragRecord.title: Record what you did
gridDragRecord.description: Now drag on a past time slot to log time you already spent

selectTagRecord.title: Tag your record
selectTagRecord.description: Pick a tag for this record too — notice the dashed border that marks it as a record

planVsRecord.title: Plans vs Records
planVsRecord.description: Solid bar = plan, dashed bar = record. When a plan's time passes, it automatically becomes a record.

tour.pastTimeHint: Try dragging on a time that has already passed

done.title: You're all set!
done.description: Start planning your day and tracking your time
